def verify_transition():
    # Tiny CPU checks consume no training RNG or CUDA RNG state.
    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
        torch.manual_seed(42)
        model = SASRec(8, maxlen=4, hidden=4, blocks=1,
                       heads=1, dropout=0.0, transition_dim=32).eval()
        seq = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2, 3], [0, 0, 0, 0]])
        pos = torch.tensor([[0, 2, 3, 4], [0, 0, 0, 0]])
        neg = torch.tensor([[0, 5, 6, 7], [0, 0, 0, 0]])
        candidates = torch.tensor([[4, 5, 6], [4, 5, 6]])
        with torch.no_grad():
            assert torch.count_nonzero(model.destination_emb.weight) == 0
            assert torch.count_nonzero(model.source_emb.weight[0]) == 0
            h = model.features(seq)
            positive, negative = model(seq, pos, neg)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                positive, (h * model.item_emb(pos)).sum(-1), rtol=0, atol=0)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                negative, (h * model.item_emb(neg)).sum(-1), rtol=0, atol=0)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                model.predict(seq, candidates),
                (model.item_emb(candidates) * h[:, -1].unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1),
                rtol=0, atol=0)
            assert torch.count_nonzero(model.transition_scores(seq, pos)) == 0

        positive, negative = model(seq, pos, neg)
        mask = pos.ne(0)
        loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(
            positive[mask], torch.ones_like(positive[mask]))
        loss = loss + F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(
            negative[mask], torch.zeros_like(negative[mask]))
        loss.backward()
        destination_grad = model.destination_emb.weight.grad
        source_grad = model.source_emb.weight.grad
        assert torch.isfinite(destination_grad).all()
        assert torch.count_nonzero(destination_grad) > 0
        assert torch.isfinite(source_grad).all()
        assert torch.count_nonzero(source_grad) == 0
        assert torch.count_nonzero(destination_grad[0]) == 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            model.destination_emb.weight.add_(destination_grad, alpha=-0.01)
        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        model.transition_scores(seq, pos).sum().backward()
        source_grad = model.source_emb.weight.grad
        assert torch.isfinite(source_grad).all()
        assert torch.count_nonzero(source_grad) > 0
        assert torch.count_nonzero(source_grad[0]) == 0

        with torch.no_grad():
            # Distinct deterministic factors expose off-by-one source errors.
            values = torch.arange(9, dtype=torch.float)
            model.source_emb.weight.copy_(values[:, None].expand(-1, 32))
            model.destination_emb.weight.copy_(
                (values * 0.125)[:, None].expand(-1, 32))
            expected = seq.float() * pos.float() * 4.0
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                model.transition_scores(seq, pos), expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
            h = model.features(seq)
            positive, negative = model(seq, pos, neg)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                positive, (h * model.item_emb(pos)).sum(-1) + expected)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                negative, (h * model.item_emb(neg)).sum(-1)
                + seq.float() * neg.float() * 4.0)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                model.predict(seq, candidates),
                (model.item_emb(candidates) * h[:, -1].unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
                + seq[:, -1:].float() * candidates.float() * 4.0)
            changed = seq.clone()
            changed[0, -1] = 7
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                model.features(changed)[:, :-1], h[:, :-1])
            # Explicit masking remains effective even with a nonzero pad factor.
            model.source_emb.weight[0].fill_(1.0)
            empty = torch.zeros_like(seq)
            assert torch.count_nonzero(
                model.transition_scores(empty, pos)) == 0
            assert torch.count_nonzero(
                model.transition_scores(empty[:, -1], candidates)) == 0
            assert torch.isfinite(model.predict(empty, candidates)).all()
            model.source_emb.weight[0].zero_()
            assert torch.count_nonzero(model.destination_emb.weight[0]) == 0
